0.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_000
0.description: Ah, I see one of <hex:02082AE0E80202FF174372797374616C6C696E6520436F6E666C6963742773FF0C746865204665617374277303> more vicious wolves has returned to the den, belly full and eyes gleaming. Come to claim your prize, have you?

13.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_110
13.description: Congratulations for crowning the Crystalline Conflict rankings! Can't have been easy climbing your way to the top─and you'd best watch your back lest next season see you overthrown.

14.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_111
14.description: Still, I'm more than pleased to present you with rewards befitting your station. May they bring you fortune and ferocity both!

15.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_112
15.description: Congratulations! You must've triumphed in nigh on endless conflicts to rise this high in the rankings. Never fear─I am more than happy to present you your rewards ere you <hex:021A020203>even consider<hex:021A020103> wresting them from my grasp by force.

16.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_113
16.description: Congratulations! Enjoy your reward for a strong showing─and may you rise ever higher in seasons to come!

17.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_010
17.description: Congratulations! You have seized the throne at the head of the table, and the finest spoils of the Feast are yours!

19.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_012
19.description: Congratulations! You came within snapping distance of the highest seat at the Feast and seized a choice morsel from the table.

20.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_013
20.description: Congratulations! Your savagery has gained you a place near the table, and a small share of the Feast's bounty.

21.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_020
21.description: Congratulations on attaining Bronze tier! May you continue to fight well in whatever conflicts find you.

22.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_021
22.description: Congratulations on attaining the Silver tier! May even more precious metals await you in whatever conflicts may come!

23.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_022
23.description: Congratulations on attaining Gold tier! May even more precious metals await you in whatever conflicts may come!

24.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_023
24.description: Congratulations on attaining the Platinum tier! Though 'tis the most precious of metals, some say gems glitter brighter... Don't let that challenge go unanswered!

25.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_024
25.description: Congratulations on attaining the Diamond tier─but never should you allow its glittering beauty to lull you into complacency! Many another contest awaits at the Wolves' Den, so you'll need to keep those fangs sharp.

26.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_025
26.description: Congratulations on attaining the Crystal tier! Needless to say, we have the highest of hopes for your performance in the upcoming season. Perhaps you will stand among the rare few whose martial prowess sees them rise further through the ever more unforgiving ranks of competition.

27.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_100_025
27.description: Congratulations on attaining the Omega tier! Rarely do we see fighters with the hunger to claw their way to the top and stand so clearly above the pack. Even so, I can tell your thirst for battle is not yet sated. Press on, and you may yet find yourself in a league all your own.

28.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_200_025
28.description: Congratulations on attaining the Ultima tier! I daresay you are the very spirit of battle made manifest. May you continue to serve as the apex to which all challengers might aspire.

29.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_026
29.description: I am afraid there is no reward for pups that failed to participate in the previous season or attain at least Bronze tier. Sink your fangs into the foe next season, and these sumptuous spoils could be yours as well!

30.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_030
30.description: Crystalline Conflict offers two types of prizes based on your performance during the season: ranking rewards and tier rewards.

31.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_031
31.description: As the name suggests, ranking rewards are prizes offered to those who achieve high standing in the rankings.

32.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SYSTEM_000_032
32.description: At the end of a season, the top ranked players for each data center are eligible to receive ranking rewards.

33.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SYSTEM_000_033
33.description: Victorious combatants will receive vouchers via moogle delivery service, which can then be handed to the seasonal quartermaster in exchange for rewards and titles.

34.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SYSTEM_000_034
34.description: Ranking reward vouchers are not subject to expiration. If a full inventory or other reason prevents you from receiving your prize immediately, you can speak with the quartermaster again at a later time.

38.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_036
38.description: Once a season ends, all the bloodied wolves who attained Bronze tier or higher will earn tier rewards. The type of prize you receive is decided by your final tier placement.

39.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_037
39.description: Those whimpering pups who did not participate in ranked matches or who failed to attain Bronze tier before the end of the season are not eligible for tier rewards.

40.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_038
40.description: You should also know that tier rewards are only available until the end of the following season. Once the following season is over, we fill the slate anew with the latest records.

41.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SEASONREWARD_000_039
41.description: If you do not wish to forfeit your prizes, then I suggest claiming any tier rewards as soon as the season comes to a close.

42.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SYSTEM_000_100
42.description: Previous season tier rewards have already been claimed. No other tier rewards are available at this time.

43.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SYSTEM_000_101
43.description: Inventory is full. Make room in your inventory and speak with the seasonal quartermaster once again to claim your reward.

45.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SYSTEM_000_103
45.description: No rewards are available for preseason rankings.

46.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONREWARDSECOND_00358_SYSTEM_000_104
46.description: Unable to obtain Trophy Crystals. Make room for at least <hex:022206E802FF022C03> Trophy Crystals and speak with the seasonal quartermaster once again to claim your reward.
